description: This file defines a Flutter widget called AssetPrecache, which preloads certain image assets before building the UI to improve performance and avoid first-frame jank. It wraps a child widget and ensures assets are cached beforehand.

classes.name: AssetPrecache
classes.description: A widget that wraps its child and preloads specific image assets to prevent initial UI lag.

classes.name: _AssetPrecacheState
classes.description: State class for AssetPrecache, manages preloading assets and updating UI state.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the AssetPrecache widget.

methods.name: didChangeDependencies
methods.description: Overrides the Flutter method to preload images whenever dependencies change.

methods.name: build
